title: Rebase and requalification procedure
summary: When a dependency roll-up changes, preserve exact component identity, inspect semantic ownership changes first, then execute the complete chain on the real ooRexx runtime. A newer filename alone is not proof of compatibility.
invariants: Hash every grounded nested package before claiming a baseline.
Run direct package suites using dependencies extracted from the exact candidate roll-up.
Treat timeouts, missing methods and assertion failures as different evidence states.
Do not weaken upstream authority/evidence gates merely to restore a downstream test.
Record exact compatibility gaps in this sphere until executable repair is qualified.
Update sphere provenance/version only after the new composition is evidenced.
procedure: Extract exact roll-up and compute SHA-256 of relevant nested packages.
Run Interaction Event -> Structured Utterance -> Brand Interaction Effect.
Run Intervention -> Effectiveness -> Governance with current Institutional Policy.
Check Runtime Registry activation surfaces where supplied.
Package updated sphere separately from executable components.
